router.sectionDesc: Share port 25565 across all servers using subdomains (mc-router).
router.enableHint: Each server uses <subdomain>.<domain> on the single port 25565 instead of a dedicated port.
router.domainHint: Create a wildcard DNS record {wildcard} pointing to this host's IP.
router.composeHint: Start the mc-router service with the following command:
router.recreateNotice: After enabling or disabling, recreate existing server containers to update their ports and labels.
router.domainRequired: Enter a valid domain name to enable the router

sleep.title: Auto-sleep & subdomain
sleep.descOff: The server stays running continuously, even when no players are connected.
sleep.descPause: Freezes the Java process (autopause) when empty: frees CPU and resumes automatically when a player joins.
sleep.descStop: Stops the container when empty: frees all RAM. mc-router starts it again as soon as a player connects.
sleep.stopRequiresRouter: Stop mode requires the subdomain router in Settings to wake the server on connection.
sleep.pregenDisabledHint: World pre-generation is active: auto-sleep is automatically disabled while it runs on an empty server.
sleep.delayHint: Time with no connected players (1 to 120 minutes) before sleeping.
sleep.hostnameHint: Join address: {address} (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; defaults to a slug of the server name).
sleep.footer: Changing these settings requires recreating the container to apply.
sleep.savedRecreated: Settings applied — container recreated and started
sleep.savedNeedRecreate: Settings saved — container will be recreated on next restart
